label: requires admin API
type: the sync function's requireAdmin() check - the subject write operation is rejected unless it arrived via the Sync Gateway Admin REST API. Structurally distinct from requiresRole/requiresChannelAccess/requiresUser: its object is an API surface (sgw:admin-rest-api), not a role, channel, or user, and the check takes zero arguments - it gates on how the request arrived, not on any property of the authenticated identity.
note: Round 3 minted this alongside requiresUser/requiresChannelAccess as a watchlist sibling of requiresRole. Round 27's dedicated requireAdmin() reference page reuses it, crossing the promotion bar at 2 distinct files. This is the one member of the require*() family the round's own extraction explicitly argued should NOT generalize under requiresRole even loosely: requireAdmin()'s reference page has no Context section and never states the shared 'signals rejection by throwing an exception' language its three siblings state near-identically - the strongest textual signal in the batch that requireAdmin() is checking a different axis (API surface) rather than merely a different flavour of identity check.
